ImageDescription.value:
set term svg size 1024,768
set key Left top left reverse
set xtics auto nomirror
set ytics auto nomirror
set mxtics 10
set mytics 10
set border 3
set samples 10000
pdf(x,sigma,mu)=((1/(x*sqrt(2*pi*sigma**2))) * exp((-(log(x)-mu)**2)/(2*sigma**2)))

set output "/tmp/Lognormal distribution PDF.svg"
plot [0:3] [0:2] 
	(pdf(x,10,0)) title "σ=10", 
	(pdf(x,3.0/2,0)) title "σ=3/2", 
	(pdf(x,1.0,0)) title "σ=1", 
	(pdf(x,1.0/2,0)) title "σ=1/2", 
	(pdf(x,1.0/4,0)) title "σ=1/4", 
	(pdf(x,1.0/8,0)) title "σ=1/8"

Plot of several symmetric unimodal probability densities with unit variance. From highest to lowest peak:
 
red, kurtosis 3, Laplace (D)ouble exponential distribution;
 
orange, kurtosis 2, hyperbolic (S)ecant distribution;
 
green, kurtosis 1.2, (L)ogistic distribution;
 
black, kurtosis 0, (N)ormal distribution;
 
cyan, kurtosis −0.593762…, raised (C)osine distribution;
 
blue, kurtosis −1, (W)igner semicircle distribution;
 
magenta, kurtosis −1.2, (U)niform distribution.

ImageDescription.value:
Discrete uniform distribution (probability mass function). Generated with the following R code: 

library(latex2exp)
svg(file="Dis_Uniform_distribution_PMF.svg",width=4,height=3,pointsize=12)

par(mar=c(3,3,1,1))

n <- 5
plot(c(0,n+1),c(0,2.5/n),type="n",xaxt = "n", yaxt="n", ylab="")
for(x in n:1)
{
  lines(rep(x,2),c(0,1/n),col="blue",lty=2)
  if (x>0)
  {
    points(x,1/n,col="blue",pch=19)
  }
}
axis(side = 1, at = 1:n, labels = c("a","a+1",TeX("\\cdots"),"b-1","b"))
axis(side = 2, at = c(0,1/n,1), labels = c(0,TeX("\\frac{1}{n}"),1),las=1)

dev.off()
